items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well I told you that, Chad.

ctx.x: I always had his music rack right up there in his office. That's right, that's correct. Speaking of dentists, this morning I rode up the Tulane with Joe Robichaux and he mentioned that Elmer Talbot's brother is a dentist.
Yeah, well I told you that, Chad.
